reports.title: Diebold Nixdorf Reports Third Quarter Revenue and Adjusted EBITDA Growth

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Diebold Nixdorf has updated its full-year 2026 financial outlook. The company is narrowing its revenue outlook while adjusted EBITDA expectations now reflect product mix and cost pressures in raw materials, partially offset by ongoing productivity improvements and operating expense discipline.

The revised free cash flow outlook reflects the combined impact of lower expected earnings and working capital requirements. Management remains focused on cash conversion, inventory efficiency and disciplined execution as the company closes the year.

Prior Guidance | Current Guidance
Total Revenue | $3.86B - $3.94B1 | $3.86B - $3.90B2
Adjusted EBITDA3,4 | $510M - $535M | $490M - $510M
Free Cash Flow3,4,5 | $255M - $270M | $190M - $210M
Adjusted Earnings Per Share3,4 | $5.25 - $5.75 | $4.50 - $4.85
